title: A2-DLC journal event
description: Draft (a2dlc-ogj). One line of .a2dlc/reports/journal.jsonl: the part of a change's history that a person reads and that no other file already records. Findings, approvals, escalations and verdicts stay in their own files; `a2dlc journal --html` joins them to these events and renders a fixed template, so the HTML is a view and this file is the record. Under .a2dlc/reports, so out of the tree_hash (gitx.Excluded) and never changes a verdict. Append-only and chained like run-ledger: hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical JSON of the event without hash); a broken chain is reported, never rendered as fine. Text fields are short on purpose: one sentence a person reads, with the evidence linked, not a transcript. `by` is recorded, not authenticated: a decision that changes behavior still needs its signed waiver.

tree_hash.description: checkpoint and decision_asked: the tree the event refers to; the view shows the verdict of this tree next to it.

commit.description: checkpoint only, optional: the commit of that tree, if there is one.

title.description: checkpoint only. What is now true, as a person would say it.

summary.description: checkpoint only, optional. One or two sentences; the evidence goes in refs.

question.description: decision_asked only. The decision alone, in plain words.

options.description: decision_asked only. Each option with what follows from choosing it.

recommendation.description: decision_asked only. The key of the recommended option.

chosen.description: decision_answered only. The key of the chosen option; the view reports a key that the matching decision_asked does not offer.

by.description: Who wrote the event: the agent for checkpoint and decision_asked, a person for decision_answered (recorded, not authenticated).

via.description: decision_answered only. The surface the answer came through.

refs.description: Optional. The evidence a person can open: a finding id, an escalation, a test, a commit, a file.
